title: MemCatalyst: Amplifying Data Auditing on Vision-Language Models via Data Poisoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.17722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance largely due to the amount of training data available on the internet. At the same time, data holders (e.g., artists) urgently need to determine whether their data has been used for model training without authorization, which concerns both intellectual property rights and personal privacy. Data auditing, particularly through membership inference (MI), has attracted attention as a direct tool. This work proposes MemCatalyst, a set of data poisoning tools, aiming to amplify the data auditing performance on VLMs. MemCatalyst employs two strategies: Poisoning Text (PT) and Poisoning Image (PI). MemCatalyst forces VLMs to over-learn specific inconsistencies between image features and textual semantics during training, thereby increasing their susceptibility to membership information auditing. translated_title: MemCatalyst：通过数据投毒增强视觉-语言模型的数据审计能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17722v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）之所以取得卓越性能，很大程度上归功于互联网上可获取的大量训练数据。与此同时，数据持有者（如艺术家）迫切需要确定其数据是否在未经授权的情况下被用于模型训练，这既涉及知识产权又关乎个人隐私。数据审计，特别是通过成员推理（MI），作为一种直接工具已引起关注。本工作提出MemCatalyst，一组数据投毒工具，旨在增强对VLMs的数据审计性能。MemCatalyst采用两种策略：文本投毒（PT）和图像投毒（PI）。MemCatalyst迫使VLMs在训练过程中过度学习图像特征与文本语义之间的特定不一致性，从而增加其对成员信息审计的敏感性。关键在于，投毒样本在不同VLM架构间的可迁移性已得到验证。
tldr: 本文提出MemCatalyst数据投毒工具，通过文本和图像投毒策略增强视觉-语言模型的成员推理审计能力，并验证了跨架构的可迁移性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MemCatalyst, a data poisoning tool that enhances membership inference auditing on vision-language models via text and image poisoning strategies, with verified cross-architecture transferability.
